# Task ID: 5
# Title: Result Registration: Unified UX and Time Masking
# Status: done
# Dependencies: 4
# Priority: medium
# Description: Create a single-screen result registration flow with auto-generated segments and masked time input.
# Details:
Frontend: Build a container component orchestrating PasoCompetencia, PasoNadador, PasoPrueba, PasoSegmentos. Implement time input masking (mm:ss.cc) using custom onChange handler—avoid new dependencies. Auto-generate segments based on selected prueba and course (SC/LC). Backend: Ensure endpoints accept segmented results and validate time formats. Use existing utilities for time parsing/formatting.

# Test Strategy:
Register a result end-to-end, verify segment auto-generation, and time input formatting. Validate backend receives and stores correct data.

# Subtasks:
## 1. Create Container Component for Result Registration Flow [done]
### Dependencies: None
### Description: Build the main container component that orchestrates the entire result registration flow, managing state and navigation between the different steps.
### Details:
Create a ResultRegistrationContainer component that manages the overall flow state and renders PasoCompetencia, PasoNadador, PasoPrueba, and PasoSegmentos components. Implement step navigation logic, form state management using React state or context, and error handling. The container should track current step, form data across steps, and validation status. Use a stepper UI pattern to show progress through the registration flow.

## 2. Implement Time Input Masking Component [done]
### Dependencies: None
### Description: Create a custom time input component with mm:ss.cc format masking without adding new dependencies.
### Details:
Build a TimeInput component with custom onChange handler that enforces mm:ss.cc format. Implement input masking logic using vanilla JavaScript - parse input characters, apply formatting rules, handle backspace/delete, and cursor positioning. Validate time format and provide visual feedback for invalid entries. Component should accept value, onChange, and validation props. Handle edge cases like partial input and invalid time values (e.g., >59 seconds).

## 3. Implement Auto-Generation of Segments [done]
### Dependencies: 5.1
### Description: Create logic to automatically generate race segments based on selected prueba (event) and course type (SC/LC).
### Details:
Implement segment auto-generation logic in PasoSegmentos component. Create mapping between prueba types and their standard segments (e.g., 200m events have 50m, 100m, 150m, 200m segments). Consider course type differences (Short Course vs Long Course) for segment calculations. Generate segment input fields dynamically based on the selected event. Provide default segment distances and allow manual override if needed. Integrate with the container component's state management.

## 4. Integrate Time Input with Segment Generation [done]
### Dependencies: 5.2, 5.3
### Description: Connect the time input masking component with the auto-generated segments to create a complete time entry interface.
### Details:
Integrate TimeInput component into the segment generation system. Each generated segment should have its own masked time input field. Implement validation to ensure segment times are logical (each segment time should be greater than the previous). Add cumulative time calculation and display. Handle partial segment entries and provide clear validation feedback. Ensure the time inputs work seamlessly within the overall registration flow.

## 5. Update Backend Endpoints for Segmented Results [done]
### Dependencies: None
### Description: Modify backend endpoints to accept and validate segmented result data with proper time format handling.
### Details:
Update result registration endpoints to accept segmented time data structure. Implement validation for time format (mm:ss.cc) using existing time parsing utilities. Ensure database schema supports storing segment times alongside main result time. Add validation rules for segment time consistency and logical progression. Update result models to include segment data and maintain backward compatibility with existing non-segmented results.

## 6. Complete End-to-End Integration and Testing [done]
### Dependencies: 5.1, 5.2, 5.3, 5.4, 5.5
### Description: Integrate all components into a cohesive result registration flow and perform comprehensive testing.
### Details:
Complete the integration of container component, time masking, segment generation, and backend endpoints. Implement final validation and error handling across the entire flow. Add loading states, success/error feedback, and form submission handling. Ensure proper data flow from frontend to backend and handle all edge cases. Perform end-to-end testing of the complete registration process including segment auto-generation and time input formatting.

**🔧 PROBLEMA CRÍTICO RESUELTO:**

**❌ Issue detectado:** La activación progresiva de secciones fallaba por inconsistencia en el acceso al estado:
- Container buscaba `stepperState.paso_competencia.competencia_id` 
- Estado real almacena `stepperState.paso_competencia.competencia` (objeto completo)

**✅ Correcciones implementadas:**
- Lógica de detección corregida: `stepperState.paso_competencia.competencia?.id`
- Corregida para nadador: `stepperState.paso_nadador.nadador?.id` 
- Corregida para prueba: `stepperState.paso_prueba.prueba?.id`

**🔍 Debug mejorado:**
- Logs de estado del stepper en cada actualización
- Seguimiento de activación automática de secciones
- Monitoreo de estado final y activación manual por clics
- Sin errores de linting

**🐛 ERROR CRÍTICO SOLUCIONADO:**

**❌ Problema detectado:** ReferenceError: WavesIcon is not defined
- Error en línea 86 del archivo ResultRegistrationContainer.tsx
- Referencia obsoleta en configuración SECCIONES_CONFIG

**🔍 Diagnóstico:**
- Import correcto: `WavesIcon as SwimIcon`
- Pero quedó referencia sin actualizar: `icon: WavesIcon` 
- Debía ser: `icon: SwimIcon`

**✅ Solución aplicada:**
- Cambiado `icon: WavesIcon` por `icon: SwimIcon` en configuración
- Verificado linting: sin errores
- Error completamente resuelto
